title: Pushes and gates are safe and the content queue shrinks
goal: check-trailers accepts a valid commit whose body has a line like 'kb-sprint:'; the sync gate sees a test file renamed out of _tools/test_*.py; a test run with untracked files still records a correct reuse key; check.py refuses tracked paths too long for a Windows worker worktree; the pack's unit cache is kept per root set; the Dataverse MCP server question packs good; the false-good rate on public-root user questions is triaged with each question listed and given a filed gap or eval row; and the queued gaps cargo metadata/rustc and os.link/EXDEV pack good
